system.traits: Disarm, Monastic, Reach, Trip, Versatile B
system.description:
This unique weapon consists of a single sickle, held in the off-hand, connected to a weighted metal ball by a 10-foot length of fine chain.

Monastic: A weapon with this trait is specifically designed to be used with complex martial arts techniques. Any ability, feat or spell which can only be applied to an unarmed strike can also be used with a monastic weapon (such as flurry of blows).

Automated (TRG Prime 3.667.0): an ability, feat or spell that applies to an unarmed strike also applies to it.

Traits as printed: Disarm, Monastic, Reach, Trip, Versatile - B.
